# SpikeEventScheduling

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The temporal ordering and prioritization of spike transmissions across synapses to avoid congestion and ensure timely processing in SNN accelerators. Proper spike scheduling directly impacts the accuracy and real-time performance of neuromorphic systems, making it a key enabler for deploying SNNs in latency-sensitive iNEST applications.
